_comment: Declared-limitation registry (ADR-035, gate.py): every check that may record a declared limitation, with the measurement that shows it and the harness versions it was measured on. A declaration is re-measured on every run: one that stops reproducing fails as escalated, one that reproduces on a version not listed here passes and the run publishes this file with the version added (expected.next.json). `*` is refused.

adaptive.reason: Codex has no documented way to disable explicit `$skill` invocation; `allow_implicit_invocation: false` leaves it invocable by the person
adaptive.measurement: the model-only Skill is listed in the person's skill catalog

adaptive.reason: Codex has no documented way to disable explicit `$skill` invocation
adaptive.measurement: typing `$flow:analyze` put the model-only Skill's body in the model request

adaptive.reason: OpenCode V2 defines no field that hides a Skill from the person (`slash` was removed)
adaptive.measurement: the model-only Skill is listed in the `/skills` browser

adaptive.reason: OpenCode V2 expands any Skill a person mentions (`@id`)
adaptive.measurement: mentioning `@flow:analyze` put the model-only Skill's body in the model request

adaptive.reason: Antigravity drops an agent that carries `model`, so UZE leaves the field out and the agent runs on the session's model
adaptive.measurement: the dispatched agent's request names the session's model, not the block's

adaptive.reason: Claude Code's native build searches through Bash (`grep` is its bundled ugrep) and offers `Grep` to the main model only on opt-in (`--allowedTools`/`--tools`) or to a subagent whose tools name it without Bash
adaptive.measurement: the main session's request declares no `Grep`

adaptive.reason: Claude Code's native build searches through Bash (`grep` is its bundled ugrep) and offers `Grep` to the main model only on opt-in (`--allowedTools`/`--tools`) or to a subagent whose tools name it without Bash
adaptive.measurement: the session did not offer `Grep`, so no search reached the `search.files` group

adaptive.reason: Codex 0.160 writes and edits files through `apply_patch`, which reaches a hook with the whole patch in `command` and no path field, so the alias cannot carry the `path` it promises; UZE leaves it unbound
adaptive.measurement: the census saw the call reach hooks as `apply_patch` with `{"command"}` alone, and no group ran with the alias

adaptive.reason: Claude Code renders every PreToolUse denial as `PreToolUse:<tool> hook error: <reason>`, the documented `permissionDecision: deny` JSON on exit 0 included; a hand-written hook with no UZE in it shows the same (experiments/claude/deny-render)
adaptive.measurement: the turn that a delivered guard denied shows `hook error` beside the denial's reason

adaptive.reason: OpenCode V2's permission prompt renders the call and never the request's message, so the handler's reason is not shown when it asks (tui/src/routes/session/permission.tsx)
adaptive.measurement: the prompt OpenCode showed for the asked call did not carry the handler's reason

adaptive.reason: OpenCode reads no `.agents/agents`, and a launch cannot hand it one project's agents: its extra-configuration environment reaches only the background service a launch starts, which then serves them to every other project
adaptive.measurement: no request of the session offered the agent the project authored in .agents/agents
